description: Promo Coherence Guard — auditable conflict types for retail promotion rules.

conflict_types.summary: Effective sale price can fall below the configured floor price after discounts stack or apply.
Multiple discounts may combine in a way that was not intended for trading.
Promotion channel scope may not align with where the product is sold or priced.
A clearance or markdown path is active while additional promotional discounts may still apply.
Two or more promotions target the same SKU in overlapping time windows, risking ambiguous or stacked outcomes.
Effective margin after discounts falls below policy or cost-based thresholds.
